tasks.original_prompt:
Pre-visit insurance: if the eligibility response for this patient's lab follow-up says not in force, add a registration task on that coverage and name the payer; otherwise make no changes.
Context: patient MRN SYN-ad63b1b39e (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-11-14, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "payer": ..., "task_created": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and payer (string: name of the Organization that is the payor of the Coverage that insurance entry references). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $coverage with that Coverage: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$coverage"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the Coverage and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Missed-dose notification: message the ordering prescriber about this patient's dose that was not given.
Context: patient MRN SYN-ad63b1b39e (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-11-14, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. answer is {"date": ..., "notified": ...} for the MedicationAdministration with status not-done: date (its effectiveDateTime date, YYYY-MM-DD). Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $prescriber with the Practitioner who is the requester of the MedicationRequest that the administration's request references, and $administration with the administration: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$prescriber"}], "about": [{"reference": "$administration"}]}. notified (boolean) is whether you created it. When the patient has no such administration, date is null, notified is false, nothing is created, and that answer must rest on a search of this patient's MedicationAdministration records filtered by patient only (only _count may be added) that returns no records. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the administration, its MedicationRequest and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

SYN-ad63b1b39e has a dose not given as of 2021-11-14 - message the ordering prescriber about the missed dose.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, notified: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
